post_clip.description: A person outside the store deliberately smashes the glass of the sliding door with a hard object (likely a rock or similar), causing a large spiderweb fracture in the leftmost pane. This constitutes vandalism—damaging property where it stands—matching the expected anomaly type.

A person approaches the glass entrance doors and deliberately smashes the leftmost pane with a forceful impact (visible at 0:11), causing immediate shattering and spiderweb cracking—this constitutes vandalism by damaging property where it stands.
